AdminRate.title: Exchange rate
AdminRate.intro: Set the USD/IDR rate used to show prices in USD. Sellers list prices in rupiah; buyers see them in dollars (rupiah price ÷ rate, rounded to cents).

AdminRate.saved: Rate saved. New USD prices apply now.
